messages:
jiwon: Prod traffic to /v1/generate -> model-prod-8 is flapping (~5m of 500s). Can we do a minimal flip to model-stable-4 until we root cause? Need the safest path, minimal surface.
alex: I can do a controlled route change. prefer control-plane rewrite (no header overrides). Plan: snapshot -> patch route -> short TTL -> monitor -> promote/rollback.
sri: watch quota accounting — the gateway emits quota events before upstream. If we switch upstream naively we might double-count. Add metadata preserve-quota or route-level accounting bypass.
olivia: also add a telemetry tag so console shows this as emergency flip (so cost/alerts are clearer). I'll post a dashboard note and mute noisy alerts for this route.
alex: Steps I will run:
1) create route snapshot
2) PATCH route to point to model-stable-4 with metadata {preserve-quota: true, telemetry: rw.emergency=true} and ttl=300
3) edge reload
4) monitor 2 minutes, check 500s and p99
if ok, extend or switch weight fully. rollback by restoring snapshot.
alex: curl snapshot example:
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routes/snapshot \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route_id":"/v1/generate","reason":"emergency-flip-1754009876"}'
```
then apply patch:
```
curl -X PATCH https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routes/update \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"match":{"path":"/v1/generate","host":"api.redwood.ai"},"upstream":"model-stable-4","metadata":{"preserve-quota":"true","telemetry-tag":"rw.emergency=true"},"ttl":300}'
```
deploy-bot: route snapshot 1754009876-1 created (ok)
alex: Applied patch, triggered edge reload (/opt/rw/edge_ctl reload). Propagation ~10s.
oncall: seeing ~5% fewer errors already but p50 latency +30ms.
sri: checking /logs/quota-events stream — no duplicate billing events so far.
olivia: added dashboard annotation + pinned runbook: https://console.internal/runbooks/route-flip. Muted the route-alert for 10m.
alex: Holding for 2m before shifting weight to 100%. Rollback command (if needed):
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routes/restore \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"snapshot_id":"1754009876-1"}'
```
jiwon: thanks team. remember this is ephemeral (ttl=300). Create follow-up ticket to RCA the flapping model.
oncall: ACK, monitoring metrics and SLO channel.
